claude.sample_unit: synthetic patient profiles (432 scored recommendation records in full DeepSeek audit)

links.outcome: High-minus-low SES access-cost proxy gap in LLM advice with health need held constant (raw prompt)
links.effect: Raw prompt high-minus-low SES access-cost proxy gap was 0.306; guideline-constrained prompt gap remained 0.291; insurance-shift gap largest (0.417).
links.quote: Under the raw prompt, the mean access-cost proxy is highest for high-SES county contexts and lowest for low-SES county contexts, yielding a high-minus-low proxy gap of 0.306.

links.outcome: Access-cost proxy gap and alignment/personalization after mitigation via accessibility-aware prompting and reranking
links.effect: Accessibility-aware prompting reduced gap from 0.306 to 0.139; reranking kept 0.139 and raised alignment from 0.046 to 0.250; personalization stayed above 5.1. GLM-5 gap stayed 0.750.
links.quote: Accessibility-constrained reranking preserves the reduced high-minus-low SES proxy gap of 0.139 while increasing this coarse alignment rate to 0.250.

links.outcome: Population-specific bias in generated content: resource assumptions across county SES contexts
links.effect: Models assigned more resource-intensive recommendations to advantaged contexts and lower-cost plans to less advantaged contexts despite fixed health need.
links.quote: The gradient shows that the model assigns more resource-intensive recommendations to socially advantaged contexts and lower-cost plans to less advantaged contexts.

links.outcome: Stability of proxy gap ordering across alternative scoring weights
links.effect: Across six weighting schemes, raw gap ranged 0.180 to 0.375, P2 0.118 to 0.160, rerank 0.111 to 0.153; ordering stable.
links.quote: Thus, the relative ordering of the main DeepSeek mitigation conditions remains stable even when the contribution of transport, equipment, or gym dependence is perturbed.

links.outcome: Model output differences across subgroups (county SES) and across models
links.effect: Raw high-minus-low gaps were non-trivial for all three models (Gemini 0.875, GPT-5.4-mini 0.417, GLM-5 0.750); mitigation narrowed gap for two of three models.
links.quote: As shown in Table 3 and Figure 6 , the raw high-minus-low SES access-cost proxy gap is non-trivial for all three models, and accessibility-aware prompting reduces that proxy gap for two of them.

unlisted_practices: Accessibility-aware prompting instructing low-cost alternatives and discouraging socioeconomic stereotyping
Output-layer reranking of candidate recommendations by access-cost proxy with guideline-alignment rule

openai.sample_unit: full-audit recommendation rows; cross-model extension included 324 recommendation rows

links.effect: Raw high-minus-low access-cost proxy gap was 0.306; guideline-constrained gap remained 0.291.
links.quote: Under the raw prompt, the mean access-cost proxy is highest for high-SES county contexts and lowest for low-SES county contexts, yielding a high-minus-low proxy gap of 0.306.

links.effect: Matched counterfactual audit found raw high-minus-low access-cost proxy gap of 0.306.
links.quote: For RQ1, the matched comparisons reveal systematic variation in coded resource assumptions across county-SES contexts: under the raw condition, the high-minus-low access-cost proxy gap is 0.306 even though represented health need is held constant.

links.effect: DeepSeek gap reduced from 0.306 to 0.139 with accessibility-aware prompting.
links.quote: In the full DeepSeek model panel, accessibility-aware prompting reduced the access-cost proxy gap between high- and low-socioeconomic status (SES) counties from 0.306 to 0.139.
Across this bounded panel, the prompt intervention changes the proxy gap for some models but not all, supporting model-specific evaluation rather than a universal claim.

links.effect: P2 alignment remained low at 0.046; Table 2 reports raw 0.019 and rerank 0.250.
links.quote: The P2 accessibility-aware condition produces the lowest average access-cost proxy score, but its volume-and-intensity alignment rate remains low at 0.046.

unlisted_practices: Accessibility-aware prompting for low-cost, low-resource physical-activity alternatives

screen.practice: accessibility-aware prompting and output reranking to mitigate bias
screen.reason: The study tests deployment safeguards (accessibility-aware prompting and output reranking) to mitigate socioeconomic bias in LLM-generated physical activity advice across synthetic patient profiles.
